name: bb-mechanics-clock-v1
hypothesis: A Skill that teaches the actor to locate the next review from the handbook cadence and the month counter, to recognise a capped stat, and to refuse answers that may cost Network or Output in the month before a review will raise first-review promotion, because in the baseline every promotion failure with stats once at the floor came from a Network or Output point lost after it was reached, and Haiku's notes in the month before the review said the review was far.
predicted_behaviour: Notes carry a review countdown; in the month before a review month fewer answers cost Network or Output; share at the floor at the first review and share promoted rise over the same-batch reference.
refutation: Refuted if first-review promotion over 25+ short games per arm is not at least 15 points above the interleaved reference, or if notes do not carry the countdown (then the text is not executed).
